PROCEED. Independent judgment: this is a narrowly scoped, guard-equivalent, accounting-safe engineering repair that matches its stated scope and the R48 direction, and the final source files match the reviewed diff.

Guard equivalence: modal_volume_path.initialize_empty_progress only chmods a positively-identified, owner/UID/GID-matching, empty 0755 provider output root to 0700 via an O_NOFOLLOW directory fd with symlink-ancestor rejection and before/after dev/ino/uid/gid/mode invariants; it returns idempotently on existing 0700 and refuses non-new/non-empty/wrong-identity roots. All existing private_records child/writer checks are retained. This correctly resolves the demonstrated R47 0755-vs-strict-guard conflict without weakening any refusal.

Privacy/permissions: the modal_assets 0o440->0o400 change is correct and necessary — private_records.check raises PRIVATE_RECORD_PERMISSIONS on any group bits when gid != SERVICE_GID(1003); the provider root GID is 0, so 0440 (group-read) would be refused while owner-only 0400 passes. The earlier R48 claim that upload preserved local mode was wrong and is honestly corrected in SCOPE. No existing-file chmod/overwrite; other uploader modes unchanged.

Budget/accounting: the reserve() change only delegates the segment-1 fresh_start case to validate_reservation (exactly one retained predecessor equal to the immutable original row; full pinned binding), then runs all ordinary cap/headroom/exposure/owner checks unchanged. The original $10.342400 reservation is retained (status ACCOUNTED, never released); the new successor is an ordinary reservation. Arithmetic is consistent (45.690453 + 10.342400 = 56.032853 < 75). The memory-cloned read-only admission evidence shows normal admission passing at 10342400 with old charge retained and an independent over-cap case refused with ITEM4_HARD_COST_CAP, originals unchanged.

Provenance/no-generic-retry: item4_job's fresh_start identity guard requires preprocessing+segment1+no-resume and an exact two-key 64-hex terminal link, so resources/quotes cannot mint a job and there is no generic restart escape. item4_preprocessing_fresh_start binds the exact original state/row/eight receipts/terminal event, commits one truthful pre-science stop (ACCOUNTED, no fabricated checkpoint/steps), is idempotent and cross-ledger crash-safe, and its authority() is a deliberate stub that raises until install wiring. Tests exercise 12 reservation-fault refusals, 4 identity-escape refusals, activation idempotency, bad-proof refusals with no charge change, and crash-replay with no double charge.

Observation fix: modal_preprocessing_provider.exists now walks parents and returns False only on demonstrated absence, raising on transport/unexpected-parent-type — correctly fixing the R47 NotFoundError misinterpretation without inferring a terminal outcome.
